_comment: The two pins this port is checked against, and they must agree.
`upstream_commit` fixes the SOURCES being ported and the corpus taken from
them; `racket_version` fixes the BINARY that answers as the oracle. Skew
between them is silent and destructive -- the goldens would record what one
version does while the code was written against another -- which is why
they live in one file and are restored by a script rather than by hand.
Restore with tools/fetch-reference.sh. Regenerating the corpus or the
goldens after moving either pin is a deliberate act, and the diff it
produces is the review artifact for the move.
notes: Nothing is installed into Racket: shrubbery-lib/info.rkt declares
`collection 'multi`, so PLTCOLLECTS pointing at the checkout is enough and
parser-tools-lib; its only version-sensitive API is string-grapheme-span,
